```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)

# 設定今天日期（確保是 Date 格式）
today <- ymd("2026-06-01")

# 讀取 CSV 資料（包含錯誤處理）
if(file.exists("data/incidents.csv")) {
  incidents <- read_csv("data/incidents.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  incidents <- tibble(
    incident_date = ymd(c("2026-01-15", "2026-02-10", "2026-03-05", "2026-04-20", "2026-05-12")),
    incident_type = c("失能傷害", "輕傷", "虛驚事件", "失能傷害", "輕傷"),
    department = c("製造部", "維修部", "製造部", NA, "廠務部"),
    contractor_name = c(NA, NA, NA, "甲營造", NA),
    lost_days = c(5, 0, 0, 3, 1),
    restricted_days = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 0)
  )
}

if(file.exists("data/inspections.csv")) {
  inspections <- read_csv("data/inspections.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  inspections <- tibble(
    inspection_date = ymd(c("2026-05-01", "2026-05-05", "2026-05-10", "2026-05-15")),
    location = c("工地A", "工廠B", "工地A", "辦公室"),
    defect_type = c("墜落防護", "電氣安全", "防火措施", "滅火器失效"),
    severity = c("高", "中", "高", "低"),
    is_closed = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
    contractor_name = c("甲營造", NA, "乙工程", NA)
  )
}

if(file.exists("data/contractors.csv")) {
  contractors <- read_csv("data/contractors.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  contractors <- tibble(
    contractor_name = c("甲營造", "乙工程", "丙公司"),
    uniform_number = c("12345678", "87654321", "11223344"),
    contact_person = c("王大明", "李小華", "張三"),
    phone = c("0912345678", "0923456789", "0934567890"),
    is_active = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE)
  )
}

if(file.exists("data/permits.csv")) {
  permits <- read_csv("data/permits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
  # 確保日期欄位是正確格式
  if("start_datetime" %in% names(permits)) {
    permits <- permits %>%
      mutate(
        start_datetime = ymd_hms(start_datetime),
        end_datetime = ymd_hms(end_datetime)
      )
  }
} else {
  permits <- tibble(
    permit_number = c("P-2026001", "P-2026002", "P-2026003", "P-2026004"),
    contractor_name = c("甲營造", "乙工程", "丙公司", "甲營造"),
    work_type = c("動火作業", "高架作業", "侷限空間", "動火作業"),
    risk_level = c("高", "中", "高", "高"),
    location = c("廠區A", "廠區B", "槽體C", "廠區D"),
    start_datetime = ymd_hms(c("2026-06-01 08:00:00", "2026-06-05 09:00:00", "2026-06-10 10:00:00", "2026-05-20 08:00:00")),
    end_datetime = ymd_hms(c("2026-06-10 17:00:00", "2026-06-15 18:00:00", "2026-06-12 16:00:00", "2026-05-25 17:00:00")),
    status = c("approved", "approved", "pending", "expired")
  )
}

# 確保 incident_date 是 Date 格式
incidents <- incidents %>%
  mutate(incident_date = ymd(incident_date))

inspections <- inspections %>%
  mutate(inspection_date = ymd(inspection_date))

# 確認資料讀取成功
cat("資料讀取成功！\n")
cat(" incidents:", nrow(incidents), "筆\n")
cat(" inspections:", nrow(inspections), "筆\n")
cat(" contractors:", nrow(contractors), "筆\n")
cat(" permits:", nrow(permits), "筆\n")
```

## 績效指標摘要 {.tabset}

### 關鍵指標卡片

```{r}
#| label: kpi-cards
#| column: screen-inset

# 計算安全天數（從最後一次事故到今天）
# 確保日期格式正確再進行計算
if(nrow(incidents) > 0) {
  last_incident <- max(incidents$incident_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_safe_days <- as.numeric(difftime(today, last_incident, units = "days"))
  total_safe_days <- max(0, total_safe_days)  # 確保不為負數
} else {
  total_safe_days <- 0
}

# 計算今年失能傷害次數
current_year <- year(today)

disabling_incidents <- incidents %>%
  filter(incident_type == "失能傷害", year(incident_date) == current_year) %>%
  nrow()

# 假設每月總工時 200,000 小時
monthly_hours <- 200000
if(disabling_incidents > 0) {
  current_fr <- round(disabling_incidents * 1000000 / (monthly_hours * month(today)), 1)
} else {
  current_fr <- 0
}

# 未結案缺失數
open_defects <- inspections %>% filter(is_closed == FALSE) %>% nrow()

# 有效許可證數
active_permits <- permits %>% 
  filter(status == "approved", end_datetime > today) %>% 
  nrow()

# 使用卡片顯示
layout_columns(
  value_box(
    title = "累計安全天數",
    value = total_safe_days,
    showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("calendar-check"),
    theme = "primary"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "失能傷害頻率 (FR)",
    value = paste0(current_fr, " (次/百萬工時)"),
    showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("graph-up"),
    theme = "secondary"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "未結案缺失",
    value = open_defects,
    showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("exclamation-triangle"),
    theme = "danger"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "有效許可證",
    value = active_permits,
    showcase = bsicons::bs_icon("file-check"),
    theme = "success"
  ),
  col_widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3)
)
```

### 事故趨勢圖

```{r}
#| label: incident-trend
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

if(nrow(incidents) > 0) {
  # 先建立月份欄位
  incidents_with_month <- incidents %>%
    mutate(
      month = floor_date(incident_date, "month")
    ) %>%
    count(month, incident_type, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    complete(month = seq(min(month), max(month), by = "month"), 
             incident_type = unique(incident_type), 
             fill = list(n = 0))
  
  ggplot(incidents_with_month, aes(x = month, y = n, color = incident_type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(title = "事故/事件趨勢", x = "月份", y = "次數") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("失能傷害" = "red", "輕傷" = "orange", "虛驚事件" = "blue"))
} else {
  ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "無事故資料") +
    theme_void()
}
```

### 缺失類型排行

```{r}
#| label: defect-ranking
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

if(nrow(inspections) > 0) {
  defect_summary <- inspections %>%
    filter(!is.na(defect_type)) %>%
    count(defect_type, sort = TRUE) %>%
    head(6)
  
  ggplot(defect_summary, aes(x = reorder(defect_type, n), y = n, fill = defect_type)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "缺失類型排行", x = "", y = "次數") +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(fill = "none")
} else {
  ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "無缺失資料") +
    theme_void()
}
```

## 承攬商工作許可證管理 {.tabset}

### 許可證總覽表

```{r}
#| label: permit-table
#| fig-width: 12

# 確保日期格式正確
permits_table <- permits %>%
  mutate(
    end_date = as_date(end_datetime),
    days_left = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, today, units = "days")),
    status_display = case_when(
      status == "expired" ~ "⚠️ 已過期",
      days_left < 0 ~ "⚠️ 已過期",
      days_left <= 3 ~ "🔴 即將到期",
      days_left <= 7 ~ "🟡 即將到期",
      status == "pending" ~ "⏳ 審核中",
      status == "approved" & days_left > 0 ~ "✅ 有效",
      TRUE ~ status
    )
  ) %>%
  select(許可證編號 = permit_number, 
         承攬商 = contractor_name,
         作業類型 = work_type, 
         風險 = risk_level, 
         地點 = location,
         結束日期 = end_date, 
         剩餘天數 = days_left, 
         狀態 = status_display)

datatable(permits_table, 
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10, 
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
          ),
          rownames = FALSE) %>%
  formatStyle("風險", 
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c("高", "中", "低"), 
                c("#ffcccc", "#ffffcc", "#ccffcc")
              )) %>%
  formatStyle("剩餘天數",
              color = styleInterval(c(0, 3), c("red", "orange", "black")),
              backgroundColor = styleInterval(c(0), c("#ffeeee", "white")))
```

### 即將到期許可證提醒

```{r}
#| label: expiring-soon

expiring <- permits_table %>%
  filter(剩餘天數 >= 0, 剩餘天數 <= 7) %>%
  arrange(剩餘天數)

if(nrow(expiring) > 0) {
  cat("### ⚠️ 下列許可證將在 7 天內到期\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(expiring, format = "html", caption = "即將到期許可證清單"))
} else {
  cat("✅ 目前無即將到期之許可證\n")
}
```

### 承攬商清單

```{r}
#| label: contractor-list

contractors_display <- contractors %>%
  mutate(合作狀態 = ifelse(is_active, "🟢 合作中", "🔴 暫停")) %>%
  select(承攬商名稱 = contractor_name, 
         統一編號 = uniform_number,
         聯絡人 = contact_person, 
         電話 = phone, 
         狀態 = 合作狀態)

datatable(contractors_display, 
          rownames = FALSE, 
          options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = 't'))
```

### 申請審核

```{r}
#| label: pending-approval

pending_permits <- permits %>%
  filter(status == "pending") %>%
  mutate(申請日期 = as_date(start_datetime)) %>%
  select(申請編號 = permit_number, 
         承攬商 = contractor_name,
         作業類型 = work_type, 
         風險 = risk_level, 
         申請日期)

if(nrow(pending_permits) > 0) {
  cat("### 📋 待審核申請\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(pending_permits, format = "html"))
  cat("\n\n> 💡 提示：點擊下方按鈕可進行審核（需串接後端 API）\n")
} else {
  cat("✅ 目前無待審核申請\n")
}
```
